verdict.rationale: Extend documents real versioning for its automations. Workflows have one editable draft and any number of immutable deployed versions, and processors are versioned in Studio. Evaluation sets can score a specific processor version, which gives a form of pre-deployment review. Rollback is only implied by the immutable deployed versions; no evidence describes switching back to a prior version or reviewing diffs. Missing for 10: an explicit rollback or revert-to-version mechanism, a change-review or diff workflow between versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: A workflow has one editable draft and any number of immutable deployed versions. Edits always land on the draft
